works.body:
Hello, my name is Ira Mishima and I am a Vtuber.
I am a Vtuber and my name is Ira Mishima. I saw your Skeb work and thought it was very nice.

I would like to have a picture of you in sportswear with the theme of "working out at the gym".
I will leave all other details to you.

I would be very happy if you could include the listener character as well. https://hub.vroid.com/characters/1537077647968553107/models/1531489271477883509

A 3-sided drawing is included in the document URL.
The character has the following elements: mature, cute, older sister, mature but mischievous, healing, calm, large breasts, etc.
She has a mole around her mouth.
She is half Scottish Fold (cat) and half human.
Her image color is deep red and her sub color is gold.

▶Uses
If possible, we would be happy to use it extensively in our activities.
(Posting on social networking sites including X, using for thumbnails and headers, online printing, advertising, etc.)
We do not have any plans to use it for merchandise at this point, but if we have the opportunity to use it for merchandise (for sale), we would be very grateful.

▶Preferred file format and size
A4 size (2,894 x 4,093 pixel, height and width are up to you), 350dpi, psd or png of one picture, one person only, and one listener character with transparency would be greatly appreciated.

I apologize if there are any parts that are difficult to understand or are impolite.
Thank you in advance.

Dear Alan, My name is Néu.

  I often see pictures of Uma Musume and I like the texture of her skin and her expression, so I made this request.
The one I would like you to draw for me this time is my favorite artist, Kikusan Tsubaki.
 I would like you to draw Tsubakikotsuki who is making a New Year's visit to the shrine with me.

I will attach the drawing of her appearance together with the picture. Please refer to it.
Please wear Hakama (traditional Japanese male dress).
 Her hair should be let down.

 Poses can be anything that Alan thinks fits the situation, as long as it is from the perspective of the companion, such as pulling hands or beckoning hands.
For the background, we would like to ask for a shrine or a road, something that Alan can easily draw.

I look forward to your colorful reply.
 Thank you very much.

Description of your request.
I would like a standing picture of Yukina - the heroine of the novel "Until the Saint is Called Again" serialized in Chinese Bilibili!
https://www.bilibili.com/read/readlist/rl508267?spm_id_from=333.999.0.0

[Character Introduction]
I created the character by fusing French military uniforms and sacred studies. Her name is Yukina, she is a beautiful and calm girl.
She always looks cool and elegant in her military uniform. Despite her neat and clean looks, she often shows a girl without a mouth.
She wore a military uniform like a ceremonial knight, with a knightly sword with a pale gold brim hanging from her waist. She wore white gloves and black boots, and her tight-fitting, easy-to-move officer's uniform looked beautiful on the thin girl's curves.

I used past standing drawings and illustrations as reference:
